_说明: 舞台第九轮「画面归老师」：学生没提要求，老师自己设计这一轮的画面（先写意图再写指令），评卷看画面是不是老师想要的样子。tools/stage-canvas-eval.mjs freeprep|freeapply
ask: 学生这一轮没说话。这一轮的画面由你自己决定：按你认为最好教的样子设计版面、样子、要不要画东西，不要照现在页面摆的凑合，也不要因为没人要求就不动。

modal.src:
dial m = must options="不加 must can should may"
sentence s = "The company {m: makes | must make | can make | should make | may make} a quick decision."
place s main
glow s.3-4
card q = "这段要回答：谓语前面加上 must、can 这类词，谓语会怎么变？" "must 必须｜can 能够｜should 应该｜may 可能"
place q below s
label n s.3 "情态动词" side=above tone=key
goal g1 "拨到 can，看 make 变不变" when="m = can"
say "看亮着的两个词：must 进来以后，后面那个词和原来的 makes 比，哪里不一样了？"
ask say "make 和 makes 比，少了什么？"
modal.subject: 英语

tense.src:
sentence s = "They gave justices permanent positions so they would be free to upset those in power."
timeline tl = 过去 过去之后 现在 将来 now=现在
event tl gv = 过去 "gave 给职位"
stand tl fr = 现在
paint tl.fr g2
label lf tl.fr "be free 能自由推翻" side=below tone=note
place s main
place tl below s gap=l
goal g1 "把粉色小人拖到「能自由推翻」发生的时间" when="fr = 过去之后"
open tl.fr move
say "gave 是过去给的职位。法官「能自由推翻」发生在什么时候？"
tense.subject: 英语

matrix.src:
matrix A = 1 2 / 0 1
matrix B = 2 1 / 0 3
matrix AB = {A B}
matrix BA = {B A}
open B edit
goal g1 "改 B 里的一个数，让 AB = BA" when="AB = BA"
say "先看 AB 和 BA 是不是一样。"
ask next "看好了点这里" button="看好了"
matrix.subject: 线代

tree.src:
tree t = 40 30 45 20 35 42 50 tray="47"
array a = 20 30 35 40 42 45 50
place t main
place a below t gap=l
goal g1 "把 47 插进去，让它还是平衡的" when="{tray(t)} = 0"
open t insert
say "平衡因子看左右子树的高度差。47 会挂在 {t.45} 的哪一边？"
tree.subject: 数据结构

graph.subject: 数据结构
graph.src:
graph g = 1>2:10 1>5:5 2>3:1 5>2:3 5>3:9
table T = _ _ _ _ / _ _ _ _ / _ _ _ _ rows="2 3 5" cols="第1轮 第2轮 第3轮 第4轮"
follow g net dijkstra from=1
follow T net dijkstra on=g from=1
open g tag
open T edit
say "先在图上把第 1 轮的 dist 写出来，再填表的第 1 列。"

sort.subject: 数据结构
sort.src:
array a = 49 38 65 97 76 13 27 49′
follow a sort shell gaps="5 3 1"
group a stride=5
open a move
@a.right say "这一趟对了，和书上的一样。"
say "隔 5 个一组，每组里排好。"

elim.subject: 线代
elim.src:
matrix A = 0 1 2 / 1 2 1 / 2 5 4
open A rowop wrong=mark undo=on
goal g1 "把 A 消成阶梯形" when="A stairs"
say "第一列的主元是 0。你来消成阶梯形：拖一行左边的把手。"

parse.subject: 英语
parse.src:
sentence s = "She has been reading the book that I lent her." key="[S She] [V has been reading] [O the book [RC that I lent her]]."
open s mark wrong=mark undo=on
say "先找谓语：从一个词拉到另一个词，再点它是什么成分。"
